name: verify_caller

messages.content: Thanks for your patience, I'm still working on that.

description: Verify the caller by phone number plus the date of birth they state. Use after identify_caller returned CALLER_ON_FILE, or when a caller wants to change or cancel an appointment. On success returns their first name, patient_id, and upcoming appointments with their appointment_ids.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth exactly as the caller stated it, e.g. MM/DD/YYYY.

phone_number.description: Only if there is no caller ID (NO_CALLER_ID) or the caller says their record is under a different number: the phone number on their record. Omit to use the caller ID.
